nuggets.text: The error is related to the import of the hnswlib-node package in a NextJS environment.
The solution involves modifying the next.config.js file to resolve the import issue.
The webpack configuration in next.config.js needs to include 'hnswlib-node' as an external dependency by adding the line: `config.externals = [...config.externals, 'hnswlib-node'];`.
